items.title: Cursor Bridge – 在Cursor订阅中无限运行Claude Code / Cursor Bridge – Run Unlimited Claude Code on Your Cursor Subscription

sources.title: Cursor Bridge – 在Cursor订阅中无限运行Claude Code / Cursor Bridge – Run Unlimited Claude Code on Your Cursor Subscription
sources.title_zh: Cursor Bridge – 在Cursor订阅中无限运行Claude Code
sources.title_en: Cursor Bridge – Run Unlimited Claude Code on Your Cursor Subscription
sources.title_original: Cursor Bridge – Run Unlimited Claude Code on Your Cursor Subscription
sources.summary:
Things sold as "unlimited" are always done so within some scope that makes it hard to abuse, on purpose. Unlimited free refills, but you can't bring a bucket to take home. Unlimited home bandwidth, but you can't use it to run servers. Yes you can technically do this, but the result is that Cursor will just change their subscription model. Because they rely on the "unlimited" access being within a scope they control that gives them tools to manage volume.
Yes you can technically do this, but the
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor Bridge 是一个轻量 shim，让你通过Cursor订阅运行Claude Code，只需一条命令，无需配置或后台进程，但可能促使Cursor调整其“无限”订阅模型。
